name: a01_sac_hybrid4_v3c_h095
description: Restart from a01_sac_hybrid4_v3b_h095 checkpoint 00050195 (critic loss ~0.09, 18-20 finishes per 20), after v3b repeated the v3 divergence about 55k transitions after its start (critic loss 0.09 -> 0.40). v2 diverged too (500-700k and 1.9M, recovered), so the cause is not the discount alone. Two changes approved by the user on 2026-10-01 (J4-13): replay buffer 100k -> 1M (100k held only the last ~140 episodes, ~12 min wall; previous buffer copied in) and learning rate 3e-4 -> 1e-4. Discount kept at 0.95/s (horizon ~20 s). Checkpoints every 250k transitions (disk: up to ~230 MB each with a full buffer). Proposition, not validated.

budget.note: 1 000 000 transitions = 13.9 h simulated, ~2 h wall at ~130 trans/s. Stop when train/critic_loss stays above ~0.2.

reward_status: trackmania_rl.reward/2, user request of 2026-09-30 (progress along the reference + constant cost per second); weights proposed in DECISIONS J4-07, not validated by a learning result; discount 0.95/s approved by the user on 2026-09-30 (J4-11)
